critical_code_review_comments: server.py continues to exceed 4300 lines — refactor into router modules (faturamento, projects, movement) still pending (flagged since iter21/22).

_build_movements uses `!=` comparison on team_splits lists directly (line ~1100). Order-dependent: if the frontend sends the same team_splits in a different order, a spurious team_splits_changed movement will be recorded. Consider normalizing (sort by team_id) before diff.

billing_pipeline stuck detection returns key `stuck_projects` while backlog-alerts endpoint returns key `items` for the same conceptual list — inconsistent API shape. Recommend aligning to a single key name across both endpoints.

Endpoint response for /faturamento/backlog-alerts is documented as containing `stuck_projects` in the review request but backend actually returns `items` (verified). Frontend already handles this but future clients could be confused.
